boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Brooklyn-campus and nearby library environments with documented study, research, technology, seating, or reservable-space features.

cards.title: McEntegart Hall Library
cards.subtitle: 222 Clinton Avenue · SJNY Brooklyn
cards.notes: Bring a valid SJNY ID, then use the library’s books, journals, databases and internet access to move research from a tab list into a workable outline.
cards.short_summary: The campus library for source-based work and online research.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY lists McEntegart Hall Library on its Brooklyn campus map, and says its libraries provide materials, internet access and academic databases to current students, faculty and staff with valid ID entry.
cards.source_title: Library | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Open to current SJNY students, faculty and staff presenting a valid SJNY ID; consult the library calendar for hours.

cards.title: Academic Center, Room 300A
cards.subtitle: Third floor, McEntegart Hall Library
cards.notes: Use this room when your draft needs a next step: schedule or attend support for writing, citations, grammar, APA or MLA rather than revising alone.
cards.short_summary: A library-based academic-support room for writing and tutoring.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY locates the Academic Center in McEntegart Library’s third-floor Room 300A and says it offers free student workshops and by-appointment peer tutoring.
cards.source_title: Academic Center | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8 p.m., Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m., and Saturday 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; tutoring may require an appointment.

cards.title: Tuohy Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: First floor, Tuohy Hall · SJNY Brooklyn
cards.notes: Set up for a collaborative session using the updated seating and technology; keep a backup plan for times when a campus program occupies the lounge.
cards.short_summary: A renovated campus lounge with seating and technology for study or meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY reported in January 2025 that the renovated Tuohy Hall Student Lounge provides students a modern study and meeting space with updated technology and seating.
cards.source_title: Tuohy Hall Student Lounge Renovation Project Completed Over Winter Break
cards.access_notes: A student lounge that also hosts campus events and activities; confirm availability on arrival.

cards.title: Tuohy Bear Cave
cards.subtitle: Tuohy Hall · SJNY Brooklyn
cards.notes: Use the casual seating for a short planning meeting or a reading break, then shift to the library if you need a quieter, more focused setup.
cards.short_summary: A casual Tuohy Hall meeting area with pool and foosball tables.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY identifies the Bear Cave as a casual Tuohy Hall meeting space with pool and foosball tables.
cards.source_title: Tuohy Hall Student Lounge Renovation Project Completed Over Winter Break
cards.access_notes: Casual meeting area within Tuohy Hall; availability can vary with campus activity.

cards.title: Brooklyn Campus Classrooms
cards.subtitle: SJNY Brooklyn · reservable group-study option
cards.notes: For a group project, ask Student Life and Leadership Development for approval before reserving a classroom; use the whiteboard and projection setup to divide tasks.
cards.short_summary: Reservable classrooms equipped for small-group work.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY says registered students and organizations may seek prior approval to reserve classroom space for studying or group projects; classrooms have whiteboards and LCD projection equipment.
cards.source_title: Conference and Event Services | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Prior approval from the Office of Student Life and Leadership Development is required for student classroom-study reservations.

cards.title: Bloodgood Garden
cards.subtitle: SJNY Brooklyn campus
cards.notes: When conditions are comfortable, take a reading assignment outdoors at a bistro table; bring only what you need and move inside if the garden is booked.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus setting with bistro tables, chairs and umbrellas.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY describes Bloodgood Garden as a campus outdoor space with bistro tables, chairs, market umbrellas, garden planters and private access.
cards.source_title: Bloodgood Garden | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; event use may affect access, so check conditions and availability before relying on it.

cards.title: The Hill Center Multipurpose Classroom
cards.subtitle: 212 Vanderbilt Avenue · SJNY Brooklyn
cards.notes: Ask facility staff about availability when you need a larger room for a presentation rehearsal or collaborative review that benefits from audio and video capability.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose classroom inside SJNY’s athletic and recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: SJNY lists a multipurpose classroom with audio and video capabilities among The Hill Center’s facilities, which are available to the university community.
cards.source_title: The Hill Center | St. Joseph's University, New York
cards.access_notes: The Hill Center is available to SJNY students, faculty and staff; ask staff about room availability.

cards.title: Clinton Hill Library
cards.subtitle: 380 Washington Avenue · Clinton Hill
cards.notes: Use a branch table for focused reading, or review the meeting-room policy and request a reservation when your work needs a dedicated group space.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public-library branch with meeting rooms and printing pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Brooklyn Public Library lists meeting rooms and printing pickup among Clinton Hill Library’s amenities and provides its current branch hours.
cards.source_title: Clinton Hill Library | Brooklyn Public Library
cards.access_notes: Meeting rooms require review of BPL’s policy and a reservation request; branch hours are posted on the location page.

cards.title: Marcy Library
cards.subtitle: 617 DeKalb Avenue at Nostrand Avenue · Bedford-Stuyvesant
cards.notes: Bring digital reading or coursework and ask about laptop availability; the branch documents public computers and laptops for in-library use alongside printing pickup.
cards.short_summary: A BPL branch with public computers, laptops and printing pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Brooklyn Public Library says Marcy Library has 17 public computers, 10 laptops, laptop loan and printing pickup, with current branch hours posted.
cards.access_notes: Laptop availability is subject to the branch’s lending rules; see the location page for current hours.

cards.title: DeKalb Library Reading Rooms
cards.subtitle: 790 Bushwick Avenue · Bushwick
cards.notes: Choose a reading-room seat for a long text or annotation session, and check the branch page before leaving because public-library hours can change.
cards.short_summary: Historic Carnegie-branch reading rooms with high ceilings.
cards.evidence_claim: Brooklyn Public Library documents DeKalb Library’s spacious, high-ceilinged reading rooms and identifies the building as a Carnegie branch on Bushwick Avenue.
cards.source_title: DeKalb Library History | Brooklyn Public Library
cards.access_notes: Consult Brooklyn Public Library’s branch map or the specific branch page for current hours and any temporary closures.
